additional_info.subject: Re: ID-DC/Si-D/UK-[MP / R4 170001889] Technical query CRM:02679000091
additional_info.body:
Hello Jeanne,
I see in the logs that the connection is in a ping pong state where it goes very frequently on&off, here the WebSocketPingInterval should be set to 30-60s  seconds in the backend to ensure the best OCPP connection.
The WebSocket ping interval in OCPP 1.6 is simply a regular heartbeat message that checks if the connection between the charging station and the central system is still alive. It helps prevent timeouts and ensures stable communication. Think of it as a periodic "Are you there?" check between the two systems.
actually set to zero
"WebSocketPingInterval": {
"readonly": false,
"value": 0,
"unit": "seconds"
},
It's generally not recommended to disable the ping interval (setting it to 0) as it can lead to unstable connections and communication issues between the charging station and the central system.
Can you just let me know the behavior of the connection after the changes?
Thank you.
With best regards,
Semih Sentürk
eMobility Tech Support Team

additional_info.subject: Re: ID-DC/Si-D/UK-[MP / R4 170001889] Technical query CRM:02679000091
additional_info.body:
Hello Jeanne,
I checked the logs and found that the issues were caused by the loss of communication with the charge controller. Normally, there is already a mechanism to restore the connection within 5 minutes, but in this case, it seems to occur frequently. I will apply a hotfix to the charge controllers to make the communication more stable and prevent future problems. I can also update the charger Firmware to the new Version if you like? Will take like ~30min and the chargecontroller update ~10min while update the charger will not be available.
Thank you.
With best regards,
Semih Sentürk
eMobility Tech Support Team
